title: CAT 2024 Slot 1 QA reconstructions — sourced, not official transcriptions

questions.subject: Quantitative Ability
questions.prompt: How many onto functions exist from a set of six distinct elements to a set of three distinct elements?
questions.explanation: Use inclusion-exclusion. Total functions: 3^6 = 729. Subtract mappings omitting one of three codomain values: 3 x 2^6 = 192. Restore the three constant mappings removed twice: 3 x 1^6 = 3. Thus 729 - 192 + 3 = 540; the other choices are inconsistent with surjectivity.

provenance.sourceNote: Concept-preserving paraphrase of CAT 2024 Slot 1 QA Q47 published by Cracku; no independent official response-sheet authentication.

questions.subject: Quantitative Ability
questions.prompt: Determine the remainder when 10 raised to the power 100 is divided by 7.
questions.explanation: Since 10 is congruent to 3 modulo 7, and 3^6 is congruent to 1 modulo 7, reduce 100 modulo 6 to obtain 4. Then 3^4 = 81 is congruent to 4 modulo 7. Therefore B (4) is correct; 3, 1 and 6 do not equal the remainder.
